blocks.text: Alag alag wavelengths aur amplitudes wali waves jama hon to complex (uljhi hui shakal wali) waves banti hain. Dilchasp results tab milte hain jab aik hi wavelength ki do waves kisi point par aik doosre ke oopar aa jayen (overlap karein). Do coherent waves kisi jagah milti hain to kuch points par aik doosre ko mazboot karti hain (reinforce) aur kuch points par aik doosre ko khatam kar deti hain (cancel). Is tarah jo pattern (naqsha) banta hai use interference kehte hain. Yeh samajhne ke liye hum principle of superposition (waves ke displacement jama hone ka usool) istemal karte hain. Do loudspeakers lein jo aik hi frequency aur wavelength ki awaz nikaal rahe hain. Figure 15.3 dikhati hai ke interference kaise banta hai. Dono loudspeakers aik hi source se jure hain, is liye in phase (qadam se qadam mila kar) waves chhorte hain. Loudspeakers ke samne har point par dono ki waves pohanchti hain. Kuch points par dono waves barabar amplitude ke saath in phase pohanchti hain (Fig. 15.3(a)). Superposition ke mutabiq resultant (dono ke jor se banne wali) wave ka amplitude aik wave ka dugna hota hai, aur hamein zyada unchi awaz sunai deti hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab yahan 'Fig.15.4-a' likhti hai. Barabar amplitude ki do in-phase waves Fig. 15.3(a) mein dikhayi gayi hain; Fig. 15.4 ka koi hissa (a) nahi hai.

blocks.alt: Displacement (10^-4 m ki unit mein, -4 se 4) aur time ke teen graphs. (a) Amplitude 2 ki neeli aur hari waves aik doosre ke oopar; gulabi resultant ka amplitude 4. (b) Amplitude 2 ki neeli aur hari waves mein aadhe cycle ka farq; resultant time axis par seedhi line. (c) Amplitude 1 ki neeli aur amplitude 2 ki hari wave in phase; gulabi resultant ka amplitude 3.
blocks.caption: Figure 15.3: Superposition se waves ka jor. Barabar amplitude ki waves (a) constructive ya (b) destructive interference deti hain; (c) alag amplitude ki waves bhi constructive interference kar sakti hain (kitab ki Figure 15.3 ke mutabiq hamara apna drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab ki (b) mein doosri wave gulabi rang mein hai, jo baqi graphs mein resultant ka rang hai; asal resultant zero wali seedhi line hai. Kitab ki (c) mein 1 aur 2 amplitude ki waves ka resultant taqreeban 4 tak chhapa hai, jabke jor 1 + 2 = 3 hona chahiye. Drawing mein (b) ki dono waves neeli aur hari hain aur (c) ka resultant 3 hai.
Do waves ke interference ke liye basic conditions (zaroori shartein) yeh hain:

items: Waves aik hi type ki hon, yani awaz ki waves sirf awaz ki waves ke saath interference karti hain.
Waves coherent hon, yani un ka phase difference (phase ka farq) constant (aik jaisa) rahe.
Waves aik hi ya taqreeban aik hi direction (simt) mein chal rahi hon.

blocks.text: Amplitudes alag hon tab bhi do waves interference kar sakti hain, lekin is se pattern ke roshan aur andhere (ya unchi aur dheemi awaz wale) hisson ka contrast (farq kitna saaf hai) kam ho jata hai.

Hamare ird gird kai type ki waves hain, jaise nazar aane wali (visible) roshni, infrared radiations, radio waves aur awaz. Har taraf se waves hum tak aa rahi hain. To phir hum har waqt interference patterns kyun nahi dekhte? Aur laboratory mein khaas equipment (saaman) ki zaroorat kyun parti hai?
Asal mein rozana zindagi mein bhi roshni ka interference nazar aata hai. Maslan dhund wali raat mein street lamps ya chaand ke gird roshni ke haloes (roshni ke gol chhalle) aap ne dekhe honge.
Kapre ke peeche se kisi tez roshni ko dekhein to roshan aur andhere bands (patte) nazar aate hain. Yeh bhi interference ke effects (asar) hain.

Napne ke qabil interference ke liye aam taur par khaas arrangement (intizam) chahiye. Do loudspeakers wala experiment sochein. Agar woh do alag signal generators se jure hon jin ki frequencies thori si alag hon, to waves shuru mein in phase ho sakti hain lekin jald hi out of phase ho jayengi (Fig. 15.4). Hamein pehle unchi, phir dheemi, phir unchi awaz sunai degi, aur interference pattern kamre mein idhar udhar khisakta rahega.

blocks.alt: Thori alag wavelength ki gulabi aur neeli wave ka displacement aur time. Dono 0 se shuru; pehle crests saath (in phase). Phir woh door hoti jati hain, yahan tak ke dashed khari line (out of phase) par neeli wave ka crest gulabi wave ke trough se milta hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 15.4: Thori alag wavelengths ki waves, is liye aik doosre ke saath phase mein aati aur phase se nikalti hain (kitab ki Figure 15.4 ke mutabiq hamara apna drawing).

blocks.text: Dono loudspeakers ko aik hi signal generator se jorne par yaqeeni hai ke un ki waves hamesha in phase rahengi. Hum kehte hain ke woh awaz ki waves ke do coherent sources hain (coherent ka matlab hai saath jure rehna). Coherent sources aisi waves chhorte hain jin ka phase difference constant ho. Yaad rakhein: do waves ka phase difference sirf tab constant reh sakta hai jab un ki frequencies barabar hon aur badlein nahi.

Ab laser wala experiment sochein. Kya hum bilkul aik hi frequency (aur is liye aik hi wavelength) wale do lasers istemal kar sakte the? Figure 15.5 laser ki roshni dikhati hai. Ise roshni ke bohat se alag alag bursts (chhote chhote tukre) samjhein. Is ki koi guarantee nahi ke do lasers ke bursts hamesha in phase rahein.

Yeh masla aik hi laser le kar us ki roshni ko do slits se do hisson mein baantne se hal hota hai (Fig. 15.5). Dono slits roshni ke do coherent sources ban jate hain. Woh hamesha aik doosre ke saath in phase rehte hain (ya un ka phase difference constant rehta hai).

blocks.alt: Teen laal wave trains (waves ki lambi qataarein). Oopar wali mein phase ki achanak tabdeeli (sudden change of phase) arrow se dikhayi gayi hai. Beech wali train par double slit wali neeli slide khari hai. Teenon ko kaatne wali khari line dikhati hai ke phase ki tabdeeli har aik mein aik hi jagah hoti hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 15.5: Saaf interference pattern ke liye waves ka coherent hona zaroori hai (kitab ki Figure 15.5 ke mutabiq hamara apna drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Laser ki roshni chhote chhote bursts mein aati hai aur har naye burst par phase achanak badal jata hai. Do alag lasers ke bursts aapas mein match nahi karte. Aik hi laser ki roshni double slit se do hisson mein bant jaye to dono hisson mein phase ki tabdeeli bilkul aik saath hoti hai, is liye un ka phase difference constant rehta hai: yehi coherent sources hain.

Agar woh coherent sources na hon to interference pattern lagatar aur itni tezi se badalta ke aankh use pakar na sakti. Hamein sirf uniform (har jagah aik jaisi) roshni ki patti nazar aati, jis mein saaf roshan aur andhere hisse na hote. Is se pata chalta hai ke interference dekhne ke liye do coherent sources zaroori hain.

blocks.prompt: Do lamps ki roshni screen par pare to interference pattern kyun nahi banta?
blocks.explanation: Do lamps ki roshni coherent nahi hoti: un ka phase difference random (be-tarteeb) aur bohat tezi se badalta hai, is liye pattern ka average (aust) le kar aankh ko sirf uniform roshni nazar aati hai.

items: Interference: do coherent waves kuch jagah mazboot aur kuch jagah khatam hoti hain (superposition).
Conditions: aik hi type, coherent (constant phase difference), taqreeban aik hi direction.
Alag amplitudes se bhi interference hota hai lekin contrast kam hota hai.
Coherent sources ke liye barabar aur na badalne wali frequency chahiye; aik laser ki roshni do slits se baant kar coherent sources milte hain.
